target.title: fix(net-policy): preserve diagnostics after redacted URL query secrets
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where redacting sensitive query values from URL-like diagnostic text could remove the trailing error detail after the secret value.

The fallback path in `redactSensitiveUrlLikeString()` handles arbitrary text that is not parseable as one complete URL. Its query-value regex previously consumed until `&`, so text such as:

```text
failed https://x.test/cb?token=abc timed out
```

could be reduced to:

```text
failed https://x.test/cb?token=***
```

That masked the secret, but it also dropped the useful diagnostic suffix: `timed out`.

## Why This Change Was Made

This change keeps the redaction behavior narrow: sensitive query values are still replaced with `***`, but fallback matching stops before surrounding prose, whitespace, or common delimiters.

After reviewer feedback, the fallback also handles balanced quoted values, unmatched quoted values, and wrapper-quoted diagnostics. This prevents `?token="abc"`, `?token="abc timed out`, and git-style output such as `unable to access '...?token='abc timed out/'` from leaking the query secret or swallowing the diagnostic suffix.

The parseable full-URL path remains unchanged. This only tightens the heuristic fallback used for URL-like substrings inside larger diagnostic messages.

## User Impact

Operators and developers keep the remediation context in logs and CLI errors while secrets are still hidden.

For example, a message like:

```text
failed https://x.test/cb?token=abc timed out
```

now becomes:

```text
failed https://x.test/cb?token=*** timed out
```

instead of losing the timeout reason.

## Evidence

Added focused regression tests in `packages/net-policy/src/redact-sensitive-url.test.ts` for arbitrary diagnostic text with sensitive query parameters followed by prose, balanced quoted values, unmatched quoted values, wrapper quotes, and bracket/delimiter-wrapped diagnostics.

Validation run:

```powershell
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run packages/net-policy/src/redact-sensitive-url.test.ts --reporter=verbose
git diff --check
```

Result:

```text
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       21 passed (21)
git diff --check passed
```

Real CLI behavior proof through the shipped `openclaw plugins install` command, using a temporary valid config and failing git URLs so the real plugin install failure path formats git stderr through `redactSensitiveUrlLikeString()`:

```powershell
$env:OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH='.artifacts/net-policy-cli-proof-real/openclaw.json'
$env:OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR='.artifacts/net-policy-cli-proof-real'
node scripts/run-node.mjs plugins install <git-spec> --force
```

Copied terminal output, with only the temporary clone directory normalized to `<TEMP>/repo`:

```text
[unquoted prose] exit=1
failed to clone github.invalid/openclaw/nope: Cloning into '<TEMP>/repo'...fatal: unable to access 'https://github.invalid/openclaw/nope.git?token=*** timed out/': URL rejected: Malformed input to a URL function

[unmatched double quote] exit=1
failed to clone github.invalid/openclaw/nope: Cloning into '<TEMP>/repo'...fatal: unable to access 'https://github.invalid/openclaw/nope.git?token="*** timed out/': URL rejected: Malformed input to a URL function

[unmatched single quote] exit=1
failed to clone github.invalid/openclaw/nope: Cloning into '<TEMP>/repo'...fatal: unable to access 'https://github.invalid/openclaw/nope.git?token='*** timed out/': URL rejected: Malformed input to a URL function

[delimiter wrapped] exit=1
failed to clone github.invalid/openclaw/nope: Cloning into '<TEMP>/repo'...fatal: unable to access 'https://github.invalid/openclaw/nope.git?token=***), retrying/': URL rejected: Malformed input to a URL function
```

Relevant real command path:

```text
openclaw plugins install <git-spec> --force
  -> installPluginFromGitSpec(...)
  -> git clone failure stderr
  -> formatGitCommandFailure(...)
  -> redactSensitiveUrlLikeString(...)
  -> fallback URL-like query redaction
  -> sensitive query value replacement while preserving diagnostic suffix text
```

Non-goals:

- This does not replace the fallback with a full URL lexer.
- This does not change userinfo redaction.
- This does not broaden which query names are considered sensitive.

AI-assisted: Yes, prepared with Codex GPT-5.5 xhigh review assistance.
